findings.message:
[P2] Unconditional HTTPS guard breaks documented local Deno dev server

The new guard rejects every request whose effective scheme is not HTTPS, but `deno task dev` serves this entrypoint as plain HTTP on loopback and the README documents that localhost uses the local RP ID. After this change every page and API call to `http://localhost:8000` returns 426, so the local workflow is unusable even though the new loopback bind already prevents remote plaintext access; consider exempting loopback development hosts while retaining the production rejection.

main.ts:5-13

summary: The listener now binds to 127.0.0.1 and the exported handler rejects non-HTTPS requests before Passport processing, which satisfies issue 46. However, the unconditional guard also rejects the documented plaintext localhost Deno development server, so the patch has one functional regression.

evidence: main.ts line 22 binds `Deno.serve` to `127.0.0.1`, so a probe to port 8000 from outside the host cannot connect.
main.ts lines 5-13 return 426 before calling `passportHandler` for any request whose effective scheme is not HTTPS.
`src/request_origin.ts` treats Caddy's `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` as HTTPS, so the reverse-proxied canonical origin continues to reach the Passport handler.
